campaigns.subject: Arms exports to Israel during Gaza war + Vance misconduct file — what you were Defence Minister for 2015-2021
campaigns.body:
Hon. Minister Sajjan,

I am a Canadian citizen writing regarding your six-year tenure as Minister of National Defence (2015-2021).

The TENET5 8-axis quantum accountability investigation (https://tenet-5.github.io/quantum-accountability.html) identifies you as one of only three Canadian federal cabinet members whose tenure is amplified by Grover oracles in TWO independent accountability dossiers:

  1. Arms pipeline dossier — sourced from Global Affairs Canada export permit records, Project Ploughshares' annual Canadian military-goods exports tally, and the Federal Court record (Turp v Canada, 2019 FC 634). Your tenure covers the 2016 LAV-III Saudi contract retention, the 2018 Khashoggi murder and the resulting 'freeze', and the April 2020 resumption of Saudi arms export permits. Six-year span, full Grover-threshold weight.

  2. CFNIS / military police accountability dossier — sourced from the Deschamps Report 2015, the Arbour Independent External Comprehensive Review 2022, and the March 2023 Operation Honour final report. You were the Minister reportedly informed in 2018 of misconduct allegations against CDS Jonathan Vance — who was later charged and pleaded guilty to obstruction of justice — and no public action was taken until 2021.

My question is simple: what concrete accountability step do you commit to taking, publicly, now that both files have independent quantum-verified tenure-overlap findings published on a Canadian citizen investigation site?

I am cc'ing the Canadian Civilian Review and Complaints Commission for the RCMP (no investigative jurisdiction here but registered as an observer), and I am preserving this email as evidence for potential Section 504 Information filing under the Criminal Code.

campaigns.subject: Bill C-70 Foreign Influence Registry zero registrations + Finance portfolio during Trudeau-Carney transition
campaigns.body:
Hon. Minister LeBlanc,

I am a Canadian citizen writing regarding your tenure as Minister of Public Safety (2023-2025) and briefly as Minister of Finance (2024-2025).

The TENET5 8-axis quantum accountability investigation (https://tenet-5.github.io/quantum-accountability.html) records you as the HIGHEST-SCORING cross-axis actor in the entire investigation — spanning FOUR accountability dossiers (corrections, foreign interference, Carney-Brookfield, and RCMP), with Grover oracles in two of them (foreign interference + Carney) independently marking you.

My questions are specific:

  1. Bill C-70 (Countering Foreign Interference Act), which you tabled, received Royal Assent on June 20, 2024. As of April 2026, the Foreign Influence Transparency Registry it establishes has ZERO registrations — more than 660 days after Royal Assent. What is preventing implementation, and what date will you commit to publicly for the Registry to be fully operational?

  2. Your brief Finance tenure (December 2024 through March 2025) covers the Freeland resignation, the Trudeau resignation announcement, and the Liberal leadership transition to Mark Carney. The Carney-Brookfield accountability dossier (https://tenet-5.github.io/data/carney_brookfield_dossier.json, Merkle 9dcd8def37b9d98b…) documents Mark Carney's overlapping Brookfield Vice-Chair role 2020-2024 and the ~C$6.8M disclosed stock options. During your Finance tenure, were you briefed on Carney's Brookfield-related holdings, and will you commit to publishing the briefing materials?

campaigns.subject: Bill C-7 MAID Track 2 and the UNDRIP Act — two expansionary bills both over organized opposition
campaigns.body:
Hon. David Lametti,

I am a Canadian citizen writing regarding your tenure as Minister of Justice and Attorney General of Canada (2019-2023).

The TENET5 8-axis quantum accountability investigation identifies you as one of only three Canadian cabinet members dual-Grover-marked across independent accountability axes. In your case: MAID (Track 2 creation via Bill C-7, 2021) AND Indigenous rights (UNDRIP Act, Bill C-15, 2021).

Both bills — which you tabled — produced legislative expansion of government authority over populations that had publicly organized against the expansion:

  1. Bill C-7 (MAID Track 2): UN Special Rapporteur on Disability Rights Gerard Quinn, Inclusion Canada, the Council of Canadians with Disabilities, and multiple Indigenous advocacy bodies published explicit opposition to non-terminal MAID expansion. The Liberal caucus voted YES 151 of 153 — 99% caucus discipline — overriding those organized positions. As of 2026, 76,475+ cumulative MAID deaths recorded by Health Canada; Track 2 non-terminal cohort growing every year.

  2. Bill C-15 (UNDRIP Act): received Royal Assent June 21, 2021. As of 2026, Yellowhead Institute's annual TRC Calls to Action tracker finds only ~13 of 94 Calls to Action fully implemented. The UNDRIP Act is the central statutory vehicle for Indigenous-rights implementation — its effectiveness depends on the action plans the Act requires the Government to produce. How many action plan items have been completed?

My questions:

  - Will you commit publicly to the position that Bill C-7's Track 2 mental-illness expansion should be indefinitely paused until disability-rights objections are substantively addressed?

  - Will you commit to a specific annual Calls-to-Action implementation acceleration target under the UNDRIP Act action plan?

campaigns.subject: Portapique July 10 2020 phone call — MCC Final Report testimony on political pressure
campaigns.body:
Ms. Brenda Lucki, former Commissioner,

The TENET5 8-axis quantum accountability investigation records your 2018-2023 tenure as Commissioner of the RCMP as the highest-Grover-amplified single-axis actor across the full investigation — 38.4% of sampled quantum probability, 6.14× amplification.

The Mass Casualty Commission Final Report (March 30, 2023) documents a July 10, 2020 phone call — supported by contemporaneous notes from senior RCMP officers — in which political pressure from Minister Bill Blair's office and/or the PMO regarding the release of firearms information in the Portapique investigation was alleged.

My question — and the Canadian public's — is direct:

Will you provide a public statement, on the record, describing precisely what was said on that July 10 2020 phone call, from whom, to whom, and what your own interpretation was at the time of the conversation's intent? The MCC notes are already public; your direct account is not.

I am cc'ing the Civilian Review and Complaints Commission for the RCMP (chair@crcc-ccetp.gc.ca) and the Office of the Information Commissioner.

campaigns.subject: Public Safety portfolio — 9 Grover-amplified actors across 4 axes — structural reform request
campaigns.body:
Hon. Minister of Public Safety,

I am a Canadian citizen writing regarding the systemic accountability concentration in your portfolio.

The TENET5 portfolio-level Grover analysis identifies FIVE cabinet chairs as concentrating 100% of all Grover-amplified decision-makers across 8 accountability axes. The Public Safety portfolio is one of them — carrying 9 Grover-amplified actors across 4 independent axes (corrections, foreign interference, arms via cross-linked Minister Blair, and Carney-Brookfield via LeBlanc's brief Finance handover).

The portfolio institutionally oversees CSC, CSIS, RCMP, CBSA — four federal agencies, each with independent accountability failure chains documented by OCI, Hogue Commission, Mass Casualty Commission, and the Mendicino Bernardo-transfer file.

Two structural reform asks:

  1. Portfolio split. The Justice-Public Safety concentration pattern is documented across four independent TENET5 axes and the Rouleau (Public Order Emergency Commission 2023) finding of structural separation-of-powers strain. Will you commit to commissioning an independent review of whether Public Safety should be split (e.g., CSIS into its own portfolio, CBSA to Immigration) to reduce single-chair concentration?

  2. Bill C-70 Foreign Influence Transparency Registry implementation timeline — 660+ days since Royal Assent, zero registrations. What is the specific operational date?
